hazards.name: Road walking and traffic exposure
hazards.description: Official route text says the section follows gravel road from Sandlågan via Bäck/Bäckfjärden to Utby, with the last kilometer before Utby on asphalt. Field reports describe road-heavy walking and traffic exposure.

hazards.name: Wet/muddy natural trails
hazards.description: Field reports and route-app reviews mention wet/muddy conditions around Småtjärnarna/Hörnsjön; one AllTrails old-stage review summarized the final segment as wet and wild.

hazards.name: Varvsberget rocky/steep urban-edge terrain
hazards.description: The final approach climbs Varvsberget and descends toward central Örnsköldsvik with rocky/steep and potentially slippery sections, plus urban stairs/streets/underpasses.

hazards.name: Urban crossings and city traffic
hazards.description: The Svedjeholmen/Hörnett/Moälven/Varvsberget/Stadsträdgården approach includes sidewalks, streets, a bridge/river crossing, railway/underpass context and central city traffic.

hazards.name: Winter and lighting
hazards.description: Sandlågan north parking is winter-plowed, but Balesudden winter visits may require snowshoes/skis. Hörnsjön is winter-used, but lighting is currently out of function until further notice.

hazards.name: Seasonal hunting awareness
hazards.description: No section-specific hunting closure found. Outside reserves, seasonal hunting awareness is relevant in private/forest areas.

importReadiness.suggestedDescription: The final Höga Kustenleden section starts at Sandlågan on the north side of Balesuddens naturreservat and follows a road-heavy corridor through Bäck and Utby before turning into forest road and path toward Småtjärnarna. Småtjärnsstugan and ArkNat Off-Centered provide basic shelter infrastructure but no drinking water. The route then continues over Vitsjömassivet and through Svedjeholmen/Hörnett before entering the Hörnsjön and Varvsberget urban nature area. The finish descends into central Örnsköldsvik at Stadsträdgården, with strong bus/train access nearby at Örnparken and Resecentrum. Treat wilderness water as untreated, expect urban crossings near the finish, and recheck the current Hörnsjön lighting/storm-damage notice.
